label: Hero 3D
tagline: Spline-grade 3D hero scenes — physical materials, studio light, damped choreography, UI in the quiet zone
description: Research + scaffold orchestrator for ONE Spline-grade 3D hero scene (one heroId) — the escalation path above the plain `3d` drawer for full-bleed/hero-slot scenes where material quality IS the message: transmission/reeded/dispersion glass, chrome with real env-maps, anodized iridescence, edge-lit acrylic, volumetric light shafts (the register defined in docs/research/spline-grade-3d-study.md, quality-anchored by docs/research/prism-glass-reference/prism-hero.html). Dispatches h3d-research-technique to commit integration mode + renderer config (ACES, env map, DPR cap) + post chain (pmndrs postprocessing, one merged pass) + material cast (per object: design-library materialId + three.js recipe) + camera/interaction grammar with damped-easing constants + quiet-zone contract + perf fallback rungs, scaffolds the multi-trio node graph (research/material/scene/interaction/runtime/container) with full per-drawer envelopes, then RETURNS a hand-off envelope; the caller drives the build with lens trios and §8.7 multi-draft cruxes (scene camera axis, lead-material axis, runtime ambient-energy axis). Routed primarily by visual-orchestrator's 3d-hero classification; also directly dispatchable on explicit user request for a Spline-grade scene.

triggers.title: 3d-hero slot escalation (the primary route)
triggers.rule: visual-orchestrator classifies a slot as `3d-hero` (instead of plain `3d`) when the slot is hero-register — full-bleed or ≥60% viewport canvas/iframe — AND the brief/intent names a material story (glass, prism, refraction, dispersion, chrome, iridescent, volumetric light, 'spline-grade', 'cinematic 3D') or performance:hero is declared. The classification lands in workflow/visual-plan.json with subagent_type hero-3d-orchestrator; the parent chat dispatches this orchestrator per qualifying slot instead of the plain 3d drawer.

triggers.title: Explicit Spline-grade scene request
triggers.rule: User explicitly asks for a Spline-grade / cinematic / physically-lit 3D hero (names Spline, prism glass, chrome scene, 'high-definition 3D hero'). Chat dispatches hero-3d-orchestrator directly with the §1 envelope; after hand-off, chat drives the build per simulation-orchestrator.md §5.1.0 shape and embeds the runtime.
